descriptions.en: |PERCENT|% Weapon Efficiency for Operator and Warframe while Void Strike is active.
descriptions.zh: 「虚空重击」激活时为指挥官和战甲增加 |PERCENT|% 武器效率。

descriptions.en: Increases Void Blast Damage by |PERCENT|% and it can now be charged to deal additional damage.
descriptions.zh: 增加虚空爆裂 |PERCENT|% 的伤害，并可以蓄力以增加额外伤害。

descriptions.en: Void Blast releases a ball of fire that deals |DAMAGE|% of the Void Blast damage and explodes after |DURATION|s.
descriptions.zh: 虚空爆裂释放一个火球，造成 |DAMAGE|% 的虚空爆裂伤害，并在 |DURATION| 秒后爆开。

descriptions.en: First Ability consumes all energy to increase damage for |DURATION|s. Deal |DAMAGE|% additional damage for every percentage of energy consumed. |COOLDOWN|s cooldown.
descriptions.zh: 第一技能消耗所有能量增加伤害，持续 |DURATION| 秒。每消耗 1% 能量增加 |DAMAGE|% 伤害，冷却时间 |COOLDOWN| 秒。

descriptions.en: Consumes |ENERGY| Energy on leaving Void Mode to blind enemies within |RADIUS|m for |DURATION|s.
descriptions.zh: 离开虚空模式时消耗 |ENERGY| 能量，将 |RADIUS| 米内的敌人致盲 |DURATION| 秒。

descriptions.en: |PERCENT|% Energy Efficiency on Consecutive Void Slings.
descriptions.zh: 连续施放「虚空弹射」时，能量效率提高 |PERCENT|%。

descriptions.en: Switching to Warframe after a Chained Sling adds |PERCENT|% Ability Strength for |DURATION|s.
descriptions.zh: 使用「连锁弹射」后传识到战甲可使技能强度增加 |PERCENT|%，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

descriptions.en: Void Sling deals |DAMAGE| Extra Damage to enemies.
descriptions.zh: 「虚空弹射」对敌人造成 |DAMAGE| 额外伤害。

descriptions.en: Void Sling leaves a trail of fire that deals |DAMAGE| Damage/s over |DURATION|s. Void Sling will now stun enemies instead of displacing them.
descriptions.zh: 「虚空弹射」留下一道燃火的尾迹，每秒造成 |DAMAGE| 伤害，持续 |DURATION| 秒。「虚空弹射」现将震晕敌人而非击飞他们。

descriptions.en: Second Ability emits a Void wave lasting |LIFETIME|s that drenches enemies with Void Contamination making them |PERCENT|% more vulnerable to Operator Damage for |DURATION|s.
descriptions.zh: 第二技能可发射出一道持续 |LIFETIME| 秒的虚空冲击波来将虚空污染浸透敌人，他们在 |DURATION| 秒内受到的指挥官伤害增加 |PERCENT|%。

descriptions.en: Killing an enemy affected by Contamination Wave makes all affected enemies |PERCENT|% more vulnerable, while also making the effect last |DURATION|s longer. Maximum |STACKS| stacks.
descriptions.zh: 击杀一名受「污染震波」影响的敌人会使其他所有受影响的敌人受到的伤害再额外增加 |PERCENT|%，并且也会使污染效果多持续 |DURATION| 秒。最多可叠加 |STACKS| 次。

descriptions.en: Unleash a |LENGTH|m destructive beam that inflicts |DAMAGE| Damage/s for |DURATION|s to any target in its path.
descriptions.zh: 释放出 |LENGTH| 米远的毁灭性光束持续 |DURATION| 秒，能对攻击路径中的任何目标造成每秒 |DAMAGE| 的伤害。

descriptions.en: Elemental Damage increased by |PERCENT|%.
descriptions.zh: 元素伤害增加 |PERCENT|%。

descriptions.en: Physical Damage and Operator Damage increased by |PERCENT|%.
descriptions.zh: 物理伤害和指挥官伤害增加 |PERCENT|%。

descriptions.en: |CRIT_PERCENT|% Amp Critical Damage for |CRIT_DURATION|s on switching to Operator. |CAST_PERCENT|% Casting Speed on switching to Warframe.
descriptions.zh: 传识到指挥官时增加 |CRIT_PERCENT|% 增幅器暴击伤害，持续 |CRIT_DURATION| 秒。传识到战甲时增加 |CAST_PERCENT|% 技能施放速度。

descriptions.en: Increase Energy for Amps and Void Beam by |PERCENT|%.
descriptions.zh: 增加 |PERCENT|% 增幅器和虚空射线的能量。

descriptions.en: Increase Energy Regeneration Rate for Amps and Void Beam by |PERCENT|%.
descriptions.zh: 增加 |PERCENT|% 增幅器和虚空射线的能量恢复率。

descriptions.en: On dealing damage, fire an arrow at an enemy with |COOLDOWN|s cooldown between arrows. 30s duration.
descriptions.zh: 造成伤害时，向敌人射出一支箭，箭矢之间的冷却时间为 |COOLDOWN| 秒，持续时间 30 秒。

descriptions.en: Rain of Arrows will also target |AMOUNT| additional enemies within 10m.
descriptions.zh: 箭雨还会额外锁定 10 米范围内的 |AMOUNT| 个敌人。

descriptions.en: Increase Rain of Arrows radius to |RADIUS|m.
descriptions.zh: 增加箭雨范围至 |RADIUS| 米。

descriptions.en: Gain +|STRENGTH|% Ability Strength for each enemy hit by the initial Tauron Strike for 30s. Max +|MAX|%.
descriptions.zh: 每个被 Tauron 打击首次命中的敌人，都会使技能强度增加 |STRENGTH|% ，持续 30 秒。最高可增加 |MAX|%。

descriptions.en: Summon forth Thara from the Void and fire the great bow into the air, blanketing the area with a rain of explosive arrows for |DURATION|s.
descriptions.zh: 从虚空中召唤出狂勇，将巨弓射向空中，用爆炸箭雨覆盖区域，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

descriptions.en: Void Blast consumes |ENERGY| Energy for each ally hit within |RADIUS|m and grants them |SHIELD| Shields.
descriptions.zh: 虚空爆裂给予击中范围 |RADIUS| 米内的友军 |SHIELD| 护盾，每名友军消耗 |ENERGY| 能量。

descriptions.en: Void Blast can be charged to manifest a shield that drains Energy for every |AMOUNT| Damage absorbed.
descriptions.zh: 可以蓄力使虚空爆裂形成一层护盾，每点能量可吸收 |AMOUNT| 伤害。

descriptions.en: Void Mode starts healing at +|HEAL| Health per second, increasing by |ACCEL| per second up to a maximum of |MAX|.
descriptions.zh: 在虚空模式中，每秒恢复 +|HEAL| 生命值并每秒提升 |ACCEL| 恢复速率，最多可提升至每秒恢复 |MAX| 生命值。

descriptions.en: When Void Regen reaches its maximum, it is applied to squad members within Affinity Range for |DURATION|s.
descriptions.zh: 当「虚空再生」达到最高恢复速率时，会作用于经验共享范围内的小队成员，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

descriptions.en: Void Mode creates a shield that grows up to |RADIUS|m over |DURATION|s. This ability costs an additional |ENERGY| Energy/s.
descriptions.zh: 虚空模式将创造一个 |DURATION| 秒内可增长至 |RADIUS| 米的护罩。此技能每秒额外消耗 |ENERGY| 能量。

descriptions.en: Allies touched by Void Sling are granted immunity from damage for |INVULN|s and healed |PERCENT|% over |DURATION|s for |ENERGY| energy cost.
descriptions.zh: 「虚空弹射」触及的友军获得 |INVULN| 秒无敌并消耗 |ENERGY| 能量于 |DURATION| 秒内恢复 |PERCENT|% 生命值。

descriptions.en: Void Sling no longer displaces enemies, instead it emits a shockwave |RADIUS|m wide and travels |DISTANCE|m stunning any enemy it hits.
descriptions.zh: 「虚空弹射」不再撞开敌人，而将释放一道 |RADIUS| 米宽的震荡波，震荡波将移动 |DISTANCE| 米并震晕被击中的敌人。

descriptions.en: When the Guardian Shell breaks, Warframe Shield Regeneration rate is increased by |REGEN|% and Regeneration Delay is reduced by |DELAY|%, for |DURATION|s.
descriptions.zh: 当「庇护外壳」破碎时，战甲护盾恢复速度增加 |REGEN|%，恢复延迟减少 |DELAY|%，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

descriptions.en: Use your first Ability to manifest a barrier on the Operator and allies in Affinity Range. It is invulnerable for 4s when first created and damage inflicted while it's invulnerable will be added to its base health of |HEALTH|.
descriptions.zh: 使用你的第一技能来为指挥官和经验共享范围内的友军形成一层保护屏障。该屏障在首次创建后的 4 秒内会保持无敌状态，在此期间受到的伤害将被添加到它的基础生命值 |HEALTH| 中。

descriptions.en: Second Ability Launches a projectile that spins up a vortex trap on impact, or tap <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_1> again to detonate in-flight. Trap lasts |DURATION|s. Void Sling through trapped enemies to grant allies within Affinity Range |AMOUNT| Health.
descriptions.zh: 第二技能发射一个可在撞击时产生漩涡陷阱的投射物，或是再次轻按 <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_1> 来在飞行中引爆它，陷阱会持续 |DURATION| 秒。对被困的敌人进行「虚空弹射」可为经验共享范围内的友军提供 |AMOUNT| 生命值。

descriptions.en: Unleash |COUNT| waves of restorative energy over |DURATION|s, each granting |AMOUNT| Health to allies within |RADIUS|m.
descriptions.zh: 持续 |DURATION| 秒释放 |COUNT| 波恢复能量，治疗 |RADIUS| 米内的同伴 |AMOUNT| 生命值。

descriptions.en: The first |COUNT| revives are instantaneous. Additional revives are |PERCENT|% faster.
descriptions.zh: 前 |COUNT| 次复活可瞬间完成。后续的复活速度提高 |PERCENT|%。

descriptions.en: Increases Affinity Radius by |RADIUS|m.
descriptions.zh: 增加经验半径 |RADIUS| 米。

descriptions.en: Increases Operator Health and Armor by |PERCENT|%.
descriptions.zh: 指挥官的生命和护甲增加 |PERCENT|%。

descriptions.en: Operator Health Regeneration is increased by |INCREASE|/s, and is doubled while controlling the Warframe.
descriptions.zh: 指挥官每秒生命恢复速度增加 |INCREASE|，控制战甲时恢复速度翻倍。

descriptions.en: Increase vortex duration to |DURATION|s.
descriptions.zh: 增加旋涡持续时间至 |DURATION| 秒。

descriptions.en: Vortex strips enemy Overguard |VALUE|% per second.
descriptions.zh: 旋涡每秒剥离敌人超宏防护 |VALUE|%。

descriptions.en: Vortex heals allies for |HEAL| health/s. Downed players inside the vortex will be instantly revived, and dead players will be resummoned.
descriptions.zh: 漩涡每秒为友军恢复 |HEAL| 生命值。倒地的玩家在漩涡内会被立即复活，死亡的玩家会被重新召唤。

descriptions.en: Vortex applies |PERCENT|% status vulnerability to all enemies within it.
descriptions.zh: 漩涡会对范围内的所有敌人施加 |PERCENT|% 的异常状态易伤。

descriptions.en: Summon forth Nidri from the Void and plant the noble staff into the ground, creating a titanic splash of water that becomes a lingering vortex for 20s. |PERCENT|% of damage dealt to enemies caught in the vortex is also inflicted upon all other enemies within it.
descriptions.zh: 从虚空中召唤义决，并将尊贵之杖插入地面，激起巨大的水花，形成一个持续 20 秒的漩涡。漩涡中敌人所受伤害的 |PERCENT|% 也会波及到漩涡内的其他敌人。

descriptions.en: Void Blast creates a surge of electricity, zapping enemies within |RADIUS|m for |DAMAGE|% Damage.
descriptions.zh: 虚空爆裂产生一次电流激增，电击 |RADIUS| 米内的敌人，造成 |DAMAGE|% 伤害。

descriptions.en: Second Ability emits a radial burst slowing any enemy it touches by |PERCENT|% for |DURATION|s.
descriptions.zh: 第二技能发射一道范围爆破，任何被触及到的敌人会被减速 |PERCENT|%，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

descriptions.en: Void Mode pulls enemies within |RADIUS|m towards the Operator, and costs an additional |ENERGY| Energy/s.
descriptions.zh: 虚空模式将 |RADIUS| 米内的敌人拉向指挥官，此技能现每秒额外消耗 |ENERGY| 能量。

descriptions.en: Void Mode emits a pulse that deals |DAMAGE| Damage/s over |RADIUS|m, and costs an additional |ENERGY| Energy/s.
descriptions.zh: 虚空模式放射出一道脉冲，造成 |DAMAGE| 伤害，半径 |RADIUS| 米，并每秒额外消耗 |ENERGY| 能量。

descriptions.en: First Ability creates a well of energy for |DURATION|s. Allies passing through the well gain |REGEN| Energy/s for |BUFFTIME|s.
descriptions.zh: 第一技能制造一个持续 |DURATION| 秒的能量区域。通过其中的友军获得每秒 |REGEN| 能量恢复，持续 |BUFFTIME| 秒。

descriptions.en: Manifests ball lightning after a Void Sling that travels slowly and zaps enemies within |RADIUS|m for |DAMAGE| Damage. Costs |ENERGY| Energy.
descriptions.zh: 「虚空弹射」结束后产生一个球形闪电，缓慢地移动并电击 |RADIUS| 米内的敌人，造成 |DAMAGE| 伤害。消耗 |ENERGY| 能量。

descriptions.en: Killing a disarmed enemy increases Operator energy regen rate by |PERCENT|% for |DURATION|s. |STACKS| Max Stacks.
descriptions.zh: 杀死被缴械的敌人使指挥官的能量恢复速度提高 |PERCENT|%，持续 |DURATION| 秒。最多可以叠加 |STACKS| 次。

descriptions.en: Slinging through enemies has a |PERCENT|% chance to disarm them.
descriptions.zh: 使用「虚空弹射」穿过敌人有 |PERCENT|% 几率解除他们的武装。

descriptions.en: Use your first Ability inside a Wellspring to increase its size, boost its duration by |DURATION|s, and grant |POWER|% Ability Strength to those inside.
descriptions.zh: 在一个「能量源泉」的范围内使用你的第一技能来增加它的尺寸，延长其持续时间 |DURATION| 秒，并且使能量源泉内的友军获得 |POWER|% 技能强度。

descriptions.en: Release |COUNT| pulses of Void energy over |DURATION|s that suspend and incapacitate enemies within a |RADIUS|m, |FOV| degree cone for |STASIS|s.
descriptions.zh: 持续 |DURATION| 秒并释放|COUNT| 次强大的虚空能量脉冲来瘫痪敌人 |STASIS| 秒，有效距离 |RADIUS| 米，扇形范围 |FOV| 度。

descriptions.en: Energy pickups grant |PERCENT|% additional Energy over |DURATION|s.
descriptions.zh: 能量拾取物在 |DURATION| 秒内给予 |PERCENT|% 额外能量。

descriptions.en: Allows Abilities to be cast without using Energy or Shields but requires |COOLDOWN|s to recharge.
descriptions.zh: 每 |COOLDOWN| 秒可以不消耗能量或护盾施放技能一次。

descriptions.en: Precision head shot damage increased by |PERCENT|% on enemies afflicted with Temporal Drag.
descriptions.zh: 对受到「时缓牵制」影响的敌人造成的精准爆头射击伤害提升 |PERCENT|%。

descriptions.en: Increases Operator Energy by |PERCENT|%.
descriptions.zh: 提高指挥官能量 |PERCENT|%。

descriptions.en: Increases Operator Energy Regeneration by |PERCENT|%.
descriptions.zh: 提高指挥官能量恢复 |PERCENT|%。

descriptions.en: Spectral pages also fire off beams that blind enemies within |VALUE|m.
descriptions.zh: 幻影书页还会发射光束，使 |VALUE| 米范围内的敌人失明。

descriptions.en: Ability strength, duration, and cast speed granted by spectral pages increased by |PERCENT|%.
descriptions.zh: 幻影书页赋予的技能强度、持续时间和施放速度增加 |PERCENT|%。

descriptions.en: Enemies struck by the Tauron Strike fire off smaller beams at other enemies within |VALUE|m.
descriptions.zh: 被 Tauron 打击命中的敌人会向 |VALUE| 米范围内的其他敌人发射较小的光束。

descriptions.en: Create |AMOUNT| spectral pages granting an additional 10% Cast Speed, Ability Strength, Duration, and 100 bonus Energy per page.
descriptions.zh: 创建 |AMOUNT| 张幻影书页，每页额外提供 10% 施放速度、技能强度、持续时间和 100 点额外能量。

descriptions.en: Summon forth Lorak from the Void and conjure its ruinous spells, calling forth a beam of energy from within. Enemies pierced by the beam have a |PERCENT|% chance to drop Energy Orbs if killed within 10s.
descriptions.zh: 从虚空中召唤落书，施展其毁灭性的法术，从书内射出一道能量光束。被光束穿透的敌人若在 10 秒内被杀死，则有 |PERCENT|% 的几率会掉落能量球。

descriptions.en: Void Blast has a |CHANCE|% chance of confusing enemies for |DURATION|s, causing them to be unable to distinguish friend from foe.
descriptions.zh: 虚空爆裂有 |CHANCE|% 的几率使敌人陷入混乱，使他们无法分辨敌我，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

descriptions.en: Enemies hit by Void Blast have a |CHANCE|% chance to be disarmed.
descriptions.zh: 被虚空爆裂击中的敌人有 |CHANCE|% 的几率被缴械。

descriptions.en: Void Mode increases Critical Chance of melee attacks by up to |CRIT|% over |BUILDUP|s. This chance gradually decreases over |DEGRADE|s when the Operator leaves Void Mode. This ability costs an additional |ENERGY| Energy/s.
descriptions.zh: 虚空模式可以在 |BUILDUP| 秒内积累 |CRIT|% 的近战暴击几率。指挥官离开虚空模式后暴击几率会在 |DEGRADE| 秒内逐渐降低。此技能每秒额外消耗 |ENERGY| 能量。

descriptions.en: Void Mode reveals enemies within |RANGE|m through walls. This range gradually decreases over |DEGRADE|s when the Operator leaves Void Mode. This ability costs an additional |ENERGY| Energy/s.
descriptions.zh: 虚空模式可以透过墙壁显示 |RANGE| 米内的敌人。指挥官离开虚空模式后此距离会在 |DEGRADE| 秒内逐渐降低。此技能每秒额外消耗 |ENERGY| 能量。

descriptions.en: Transfer to Operator with |THRESHOLD|x Combo Multiplier to increase AMP damage by |PERCENT|% for |DURATION|s.
descriptions.zh: 拥有 |THRESHOLD|x 连击倍率时传识到指挥官可使增幅器伤害提高 |PERCENT|%，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

descriptions.en: Void Sling no longer displaces enemies, instead it will open them up to Finishers and increase Finisher Damage taken by |DAMAGE|%.
descriptions.zh: 「虚空弹射」不再撞开敌人，而将使敌人可被终结，并增加 |DAMAGE|% 的处决伤害。

descriptions.en: Creates a wave while dashing, increasing the Damage by |DAMAGE|% and the area of effect around the Operator by |RADIUS|m.
descriptions.zh: 冲刺期间产生一道波浪，增加 |DAMAGE|% 的伤害，增加指挥官身边的影响范围 |RADIUS| 米。

descriptions.en: Initiating a finisher as Operator switches to Warframe, increasing melee Critical Chance by |PERCENT|% for |DURATION|s.
descriptions.zh: 作为指挥官施展处决时会切换到战甲，|DURATION| 秒内提升 |PERCENT|% 近战暴击几率。

descriptions.en: Additional |PERCENT|% Weapon Damage per Lifted enemy attacked by Operator. Lasts for |DURATION|s, stacks up to |STACKS|x.
descriptions.zh: 攻击被「虚空悬浮」浮空的敌人，每个敌人可使指挥官获得 |PERCENT|% 额外武器伤害。持续 |DURATION| 秒，最多可叠加 |STACKS| 层。

descriptions.en: First Ability creates a |WIDTH|m wide shockwave lasting |DURATION|s, that inflicts Lift Status on all enemies it touches.
descriptions.zh: 第一技能发射宽 |WIDTH| 米的冲击波，持续 |DURATION| 秒，冲击波触及的敌人将被悬空。

descriptions.en: Second Ability increases the width of the next Void Sling by |RADIUS|% and enemies hit are vulnerable to Finishers, taking |DAMAGE|% more finisher damage.
descriptions.zh: 第二技能增加 |RADIUS|% 下次施放「虚空弹射」的宽度，被击中的敌人会更容易受到处决攻击，他们受到的处决伤害将提升 |DAMAGE|%。

descriptions.en: Increases maximum Void Sling distance by |val|%.
descriptions.zh: 增加 |val|% 虚空弹射的最大距离。

descriptions.en: Performing a Slam as Operator switches to Warframe and grants double Combo gain for |DURATION|s.
descriptions.zh: 作为指挥官施展震地攻击时，会切换到战甲并在 |DURATION| 秒内获得双倍连击增益。

descriptions.en: Spectral weapons have a |VALUE|% chance to attack the same enemy a second time.
descriptions.zh: 幻影武器有 |VALUE|% 的几率再次攻击同一个敌人。

descriptions.en: Summon |NUM_SWORDS| spectral swords that are copies of equipped melee weapon. Melee attacks will simultaneously trigger spectral attacks on any enemies within 10m for 30s. Spectral sword hits increase Combo Count and grant extra Tauron Strike Charge. Spectral swords are granted to all players in Affinity Range.
descriptions.zh: 召唤 |NUM_SWORDS| 把与当前装备的近战武器相同的幻影之刃。进行近战攻击时，幻影之刃同时对 10 米范围内的所有敌人进行同步攻击，持续 30 秒。幻影之刃的攻击会增加连击数，并提供额外的 Tauron 打击充能。经验共享范围内的玩家都会获得幻影之刃。

descriptions.en: Increase the range of spectral melee attacks to |RANGE|m.
descriptions.zh: 幻影近战攻击的范围增加到 |RANGE| 米。

descriptions.en: Tauron Strike slash size is increased by |VALUE|%.
descriptions.zh: Tauron 打击的切割范围增加 |VALUE|%。

descriptions.en: Summon forth Vexoric from the Void and swing the colossal sword, unleashing a wave of devastating energy. Gain +|COMBO| Melee Combo from each enemy hit.
descriptions.zh: 从虚空中召唤断命，挥舞巨剑，释放毁灭性的能量波。每次击中敌人，获得 |COMBO| 近战连击数。

descriptions.en: Melee Combo Counter now decays while out of combat by |AMOUNT| every few seconds, instead of depleting completely.
descriptions.zh: 脱离战斗后每隔几秒，近战连击数衰减 |AMOUNT|，而非完全归零。

descriptions.en: Kills from Melee Attacks grant |PERCENT|% more Melee Affinity.
descriptions.zh: 近战击杀获得额外 |PERCENT|% 的近战武器经验值。

descriptions.en: Increases Void Sling Speed by |PERCENT|%.
descriptions.zh: 增加「虚空弹射」|PERCENT|% 的速度。

descriptions.en: Increases Operator Movement Speed by |PERCENT|%.
descriptions.zh: 增加指挥官的移动速度 |PERCENT|%。

descriptions.en: Unleash |COUNT| bursts of psychic energy over |DURATION|s that inflict Confusion on enemies within a |RADIUS|m, |FOV| degree cone.
descriptions.zh: 持续|DURATION| 秒释放出 |COUNT| 次心灵能量来使敌人进入混乱状态，有效距离 |RADIUS| 米，扇形范围|FOV| 度。

descriptions.en: Enemies hit by Void Blast are affected by Magnetize for |DURATION|s.
descriptions.zh: 被虚空爆裂击中的敌人将吸引子弹，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

descriptions.en: Void Blast has a |CHANCE|% chance to summon a Wisp when it damages an enemy. The Wisp can be picked up by allies to increase Operator Damage by |DAMAGE|% for |DURATION|s.
descriptions.zh: 虚空爆裂对一名敌人造成伤害时，将有 |CHANCE|% 的几率召唤一个虚灵。此虚灵可以被友军捡起以增加指挥官 |DAMAGE|% 的伤害，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

descriptions.en: |PCT|% chance to clear Transference Static on kill while Reinforced Return is active.
descriptions.zh: 「强化回归」激活时，击杀敌人有 |PCT|% 概率清除传识干扰。

descriptions.en: Void Mode now renders allies within |RADIUS|m invisible. This ability costs an additional |ENERGY| Energy/s per ally cloaked.
descriptions.zh: 虚空模式现使 |RADIUS| 米内的友军隐身。每遮蔽一名友军，此技能每秒额外消耗 |ENERGY| 能量。

descriptions.en: Void Mode reduces damage taken by invisible allies within |RADIUS|m by |PERCENT|%. This ability costs an additional |ENERGY| Energy/s.
descriptions.zh: 虚空模式使 |RADIUS| 米内的隐身友军减伤 |PERCENT|% 。此技能每秒额外消耗 |ENERGY| 能量。

descriptions.en: Using Void Sling through an enemy will reduce their Armor by |PERCENT|%.
descriptions.zh: 使用「虚空弹射」穿过敌人，降低其 |PERCENT|% 的护甲。

descriptions.en: Using Void Sling through an enemy will reduce their Damage by |PERCENT|%.
descriptions.zh: 使用「虚空弹射」穿过敌人，降低其 |PERCENT|% 的输出伤害。

descriptions.en: Warframe is invulnerable for |DURATION|s after Operator is downed. Tap <USE> as Operator falls to bring the Warframe to the Operator’s location.
descriptions.zh: 指挥官被击败后，战甲进入无敌状态 |DURATION| 秒。指挥官被击败时按 <USE> 将战甲召唤到指挥官的位置。

descriptions.en: Gain immunity to slow, stagger, and knockdown effects for |DURATION|s after transferring between Operator or Warframe.
descriptions.zh: 在指挥官或战甲之间传识可获得 |DURATION| 秒免疫减速，失衡和击倒效果。

descriptions.en: Void Sling out of a Magnetic Flare to refresh its duration and increase its radius by |PERCENT|%.
descriptions.zh: 使用「虚空弹射」脱离「磁耀力场」的范围来刷新它的持续时间，并为其提升 |PERCENT|% 范围。

descriptions.en: Use your first Ability to create a |RADIUS|m radius field that lasts for |DURATION|s and disables the shields of any enemy that enters it.
descriptions.zh: 使用你的第一技能来创造一个半径 |RADIUS| 米的力场，持续 |DURATION| 秒，消除所有力场内敌人的护盾。

descriptions.en: Second Ability launches an energy bomb that explodes with a |RADIUS|m radius, stripping |PERCENT|% of enemy armor. Tap <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_1> again to detonate in-flight.
descriptions.zh: 第二技能发射一枚爆炸半径 |RADIUS| 米的能量爆弹，削减敌人 |PERCENT|% 护甲。再次使用 <ACTIVATE_ABILITY_1> 可在爆弹飞行过程中引爆。

descriptions.en: |PERCENT|% chance to summon an Unairu Wisp per enemy hit by Caustic Strike. The Wisp will seek out the nearest ally within Affinity Range, increasing Operator damage by |DAMAGE|% for |DURATION|s.
descriptions.zh: 每个被「侵蚀打击」击中的敌人都有 |PERCENT|% 几率召唤一个 Unairu 虚灵。虚灵将自动搜寻经验共享范围内最近的友军，使指挥官伤害提高 |DAMAGE|%，持续 |DURATION| 秒。

descriptions.en: Increases Armor for Warframe and Operator by |VALUE|.
descriptions.zh: 增加战甲和指挥官 |VALUE| 护甲

descriptions.en: |PERCENT|% Damage taken is returned to the attacker.
descriptions.zh: |PERCENT|% 的伤害会返还给攻击者。

descriptions.en: During Last Gasp, Operator Damage is increased by |BASE|% plus an additional |PCT|% per second.
descriptions.zh: 在「弥留之际」期间，指挥官伤害增加 |BASE|% 且每秒增加 |PCT|% 额外伤害。

descriptions.en: Revive your Warframe by transferring to Operator and killing 3 enemies before |DURATION|s elapse and the Revive Meter begins to drain.
descriptions.zh: 通过传识成指挥官，并在复活计量表耗尽之前于 |DURATION| 秒内击杀 3 个敌人来复活你的战甲。

descriptions.en: Increases Operator Armor by |INCREASE|%.
descriptions.zh: 指挥官的护甲增加 |INCREASE|%。

descriptions.en: Increases Void Blast radius by |PERCENT|%.
descriptions.zh: 虚空爆裂的半径增加 |PERCENT|%。

descriptions.en: Shockwaves create |AMOUNT| Armor Motes that grant +450 temporary Armor. Max 5.
descriptions.zh: 冲击波生成 |AMOUNT| 护甲微粒，提供 450 临时护甲。最多五个。

descriptions.en: Shockwaves generate |COUNT| pickups, in the form of Universal Orbs or Ammo.
descriptions.zh: 冲击波生成 |COUNT| 个拾取物（通用补给球或是弹药）。

descriptions.en: Increase shockwave radius by +|VALUE|%.
descriptions.zh: 冲击波范围增加 |VALUE|%。

descriptions.en: Cogron Tauron Strikes enable their shockwave effect for the next |VALUE| aerial Melee slam attacks.
descriptions.zh: 克戎 Tauron 打击会使接下来 |VALUE| 次空中近战震地攻击开启冲击波效果。

descriptions.en: Summon forth Cogron from the Void and brandish the mighty hammer, slamming it into the ground to create a cataclysmic shockwave that ripples |NUM| times.
descriptions.zh: 从虚空中召唤出克戎，挥舞强大的战锤，将其猛击地面，释放出连续扩散 |NUM| 次的灾难性冲击波。

descriptions.en: Unleash a ray of petrifying energy for |DURATION|s that turns enemies into stone for |FREEZE_DURATION|s.
descriptions.zh: 持续 |DURATION| 秒射出一道石化能量射线，将敌人转化为石头 |FREEZE_DURATION| 秒。
